source_basis.primary_methodological_source: Cooper et al., A dataset of rated conceptual arguments, especially Section 2 and Appendices C, D, and F

design_limitations: Four critiques share one position and one rater pair.
Each rater pair appears on only one position, so pair-specific interaction is confounded with position.
The twelve positions are purposively selected rather than sampled from a defined population.
Six raters and four positions per rater do not support stable reliability weights or public rater rankings.

notation.position_summary: arithmetic mean across the four paired critiques
notation.pilot_summary: equal-position-weighted mean and median across twelve position summaries

components: twelve position-level mean absolute overall gaps
twelve position-level mean absolute centrality-times-strength gaps
complete, mixed-clarity, integrity-flagged, and incomplete position counts
total and distributional active rating time
safe decline, rejection, replacement, integrity, verification, check, revision, adjudication, and unresolved counts

secondary_endpoints.classification: Metaphilosophy extension, not an LMCA source metric or ground-truth error

secondary_endpoints.forbidden_weight: absolute difference between two-rater mean scores

exploratory_only: topic, source, length, style-cue, and order associations
model diagnostics after human analysis freeze
formal resampling under an explicit exchangeability assumption

missing_data_policy.valid_replacement: new independently blinded initial rating by a pre-authorized eligible replacement rater with no peer or model exposure

procedural_completion_requires: 96 accepted or validly replaced blind initial ratings
all required review cases closed or explicitly unresolved
all stages and causes preserved without overwriting initials
reproducible complete analysis and audit package

minimal_patch_plan_after_separate_author: freeze an approved machine-readable amendment and verifier
extend controlled rating schema, service, storage, and UI for interpretation fields and any approved self-check stage
amend the analysis engine for position-first primary gaps, symmetric discrepancy, corrected ordering weights, rater deletion, aggregation sensitivity, stage separation, and missingness
add a complete twelve-position synthetic fixture and focused regression tests
update pilot plan, analysis, adjudication, and methodology contracts without changing production claims

options.A: all 96 initial ratings; approximately 8 to 24 additional core-rater hours using the LMCA planning range
options.B: balanced 24-rating subsample: six positions, one per topic and three per source class; two critiques per selected position; four self-checks per rater; approximately 2 to 6 additional core-rater hours
options.C: no mandatory self-check; checking cannot be separated from outcome-triggered discussion or revision

options.A: two adjudicators independently code all 48 paired fingerprints before seeing numeric score gaps
options.B: one blinded code for all 48; dual code all mismatches plus a prespecified random audit of apparently compatible pairs
options.C: code only score-gap or ambiguity-triggered cases; prevalence across all 48 cannot be estimated
